issues.ko:
기술은 타입이 하나이고, 포켓몬은 타입이 하나 또는 둘이다. 기술이 주는 피해의 배수는 아래 표를 따른다. 표에 없는 조합은 1배다. 포켓몬의 타입이 둘이면 두 타입에 대한 배수를 곱한다. 배수가 클수록 피해가 크다.
- 불 기술: 풀에 2배, 불·물에 0.5배
- 물 기술: 불·땅에 2배, 물·풀에 0.5배
- 풀 기술: 물·땅에 2배, 불·풀·비행에 0.5배
- 전기 기술: 물·비행에 2배, 풀·전기에 0.5배, 땅에 0배(피해 없음)
- 땅 기술: 전기에 2배, 불·풀에 0.5배, 비행에 0배(피해 없음)
- 비행 기술: 풀에 2배, 전기에 0.5배
issues.en:
A move has one type, and a Pokémon has one or two types. The multiplier of the damage a move deals follows the table below. Combinations not in the table are 1x. If a Pokémon has two types, the multipliers against the two types are multiplied together. The larger the multiplier, the greater the damage.
- Fire move: 2x against Grass, 0.5x against Fire·Water
- Water move: 2x against Fire·Ground, 0.5x against Water·Grass
- Grass move: 2x against Water·Ground, 0.5x against Fire·Grass·Flying
- Electric move: 2x against Water·Flying, 0.5x against Grass·Electric, 0x against Ground (no damage)
- Ground move: 2x against Electric, 0.5x against Fire·Grass, 0x against Flying (no damage)
- Flying move: 2x against Grass, 0.5x against Electric
issues.explanation: Judgment call reviewed: in Korean the 가운뎃점 lists types in the table ('불·물에 0.5배') and also joins a dual type in the situations ('불·물 두 타입'); keeping '·' carries that exact overlap into English, and 'Fire·Grass·Flying' (three types) shows it is a list. English has no set reading of '·', so it is slightly more opaque, but 'and', '/' or ',' would either settle or worsen the overlap; keep in all three rules and both dual-type situations.
